title: 11 Best Birria in Guadalajara (2026)
description: The best birria in Guadalajara, Mexico — curated from Reddit reviews and local food blogs. Goat, beef, and pork birria from legendary birrierías.

picks.name: Birriería Las 9 Esquinas
picks.address: C. Colón 384, Zona Centro, 44100 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
picks.insiderTip: Ask for the tacos dorados de birria and dip them in the consomé. Go early on weekends to avoid the tourist rush.

picks.name: Birriería Chololo
picks.address: Calle, San Antonio 288, Las Juntas, 45590 San Pedro Tlaquepaque, Jal., Mexico
picks.insiderTip: Go on Sunday for live music and the full experience. Order the mixed plate (plato surtido) for different cuts of goat.

picks.name: Birriería La Victoria
picks.address: C. Manuel Acuña 1511, Villaseñor, 44200 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
picks.insiderTip: Ask for your birria 'bien doradito' (extra crispy). Spread beans on your tortillas for tacos. The mild ranchero salsa is great.

picks.name: Birriería Aceves
picks.address: C. 4 453, Comercial Abastos, 44530 Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico
picks.insiderTip: Get the taco de gordito to dip in your consomé. They sell out by 1 PM so arrive early. Closed Wednesdays.

picks.name: Birriería David
picks.address: C. Joaquin Angulo 188 E, Centro Barranquitas, 44280 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
picks.insiderTip: Get a fresh pineapple juice from the vendors on the other side of the market before sitting down. Try the machito (mild here).

picks.name: Karne Garibaldi
picks.address: Calle Garibaldi 1306, Santa Teresita, 44200 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
picks.insiderTip: Food arrives within 13 seconds of ordering — it's a Guinness Record. Try the carne en su jugo chica (small) with their house salsa.

picks.name: La Panga del Impostor
picks.address: C. Miguel Lerdo de Tejada 2189, Col Americana, Americana, 44160 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
picks.insiderTip: Order the birria de almeja (clam birria) — clam and shrimp in beef birria broth. A totally unique take featured in Condé Nast Traveler.

picks.name: Birriería Cocula
picks.address: Calz del Federalismo Nte 1374, Mezquitan, 44260 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
picks.insiderTip: Try the rare birria de cerdo (pork) — it's their specialty and hard to find elsewhere in the city. Closed Mondays.

picks.name: El Cortijo Taco de Birria
picks.address: Calle Gral. Eulogio Parra 2437, Ladrón de Guevara, 44600 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
picks.insiderTip: Order several tacos de birria and dip them in the consomé. Simple, cheap, perfect. Recommended by Condé Nast Traveler.

picks.name: Birria El Güero
picks.address: C. Sebastian Allende 954, Talpita, 44710 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
picks.insiderTip: Opens at 7:30 AM — come early for the freshest birria. Pure local crowd, no tourist infrastructure.

picks.name: Plaza de las 9 Esquinas (Multiple Vendors)
picks.address: Plaza de las 9 Esquinas, Zona Centro, Guadalajara
picks.insiderTip: Walk the square and peek into each birriería — try small plates at 2-3 spots and compare. Great starting point for a birria tasting tour.
